title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: Source was the local rfe-snapshot.md (Jira unreachable).
Scope follows the strategy, not the original RFE: input-only, no audio output, no microphone capture, no PDF, no video.
Model selection shown as a toggle group of three sample models with catalog capability tags (image-inferencing, audio-asr).
ASR capability flag UX in AI Asset Endpoints is modeled as an 'Edit capabilities' modal with a checkbox; final design is an open question in the strategy.
File size limit assumed at the proposed 10 MB default (pending PM confirmation).
Processing feedback shown as sequential status messages: Uploading, Transcribing audio, Generating response.
'Use sample image/audio' buttons exist only to make the prototype demoable without real files.
